author: Fixture Reporter
content:
A competing account of Apple's M8 Ultra AI server project says its intended launch year was 2028 at the time of the September 16 report. That conflicts with the earlier account that Apple did not expect a launch before 2029.

The account refers to the same proposed server using two or four M8 Ultra chips and potentially Nvidia NVLink Fusion. It does not describe a newly accelerated schedule or a different product.

The project remains conditional: it could be canceled, and use of Nvidia technology has not been finalized. The disagreement concerns the launch expectation already in place when the original report was published.
headline: Competing Account Puts Apple's M8 Ultra AI Server Launch Target In 2028
summary: A competing report says Apple was targeting 2028 when the September 16 server report appeared, disputing the claim that no launch was expected before 2029.
